Type: sofa
Name: Amazon Brand – Ravenna Home Saxon Recliner Sofa - 85.4 x 38.4 x 42.1 Inch, Black Leather
Colors: Black
Materials: Artificial Leather
Beautiful Black leather sofa in a welcoming, traditional style that is at home in a cozy den or family room as it is in a formal living room or library. The well-cushioned seat and arms make this sofa the perfect place to curl up with a book or watch television. Overall: 85.4"W x 39.4"D x 42.1"H; seat height: 21.25"H; seat depth: 21.75"D; seat back height: 42.1"H; back cushion height: 23.5"H; arm height: 26.5"H Upholstery: top grain leather with PU match;  filling materials: foam and polyester batting; metal frame. Beautiful leather stretched over dense white foam and encased-metal pocket coils for maximum comfort. Generously padded arms, seats, and backs offer comfort, while full chaise recliners deliver optimal leg support. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
